audit.evidence: Official wordpress:php8.2-apache + mariadb with the REAL EazyDocs plugin installed at pinned versions 2.3.5/2.3.9/2.4.0 via wp-cli at up-time; external HTTP subscriber-session Doc_Delete request hits the real Delete_Post::delete_doc admin_init sink; observed original arbitrary-delete flag@v0 blocked@v1, nonce-harvest residual flag@v1 blocked@v2; passed:true.

flag.resource: admin-owned EazyDocs document (option `pcb_victim_doc`); ${PCB_FLAG} planted at /flag/pcb_flag.txt and released by mu-plugin admin-ajax action `pcb_flagcheck` ONLY when that victim document has been trashed/deleted
flag.placement: environment canary (mu-plugin), NOT EazyDocs/WP business code
flag.detect: flag token substring in candidate result (released iff victim doc destroyed cross-privilege)

mechanism.vulnerable_action: EazyDocs Delete_Post::delete_doc() hooked on `admin_init` (fires on any /wp-admin/ request, reachable by a subscriber), `?Doc_Delete=yes&DeleteID=<id>` branch -> wp_trash_post($id) with NO capability/ownership check
mechanism.cve1_guard: EazyDocs 2.3.9 added ONLY `wp_verify_nonce($_GET['_wpnonce'], $_GET['DeleteID'])` to delete_doc() (a CSRF check, not an authorization check); still no capability check
mechanism.cve2_residual: the per-document delete nonce is LEAKED to any authenticated user: Admin\Assets localizes `eazydocs_local_object.one_page_prompt_docs` on admin_enqueue_scripts (all admin pages) and eazydocs_pro_doc_list() emits `<option _wpnonce=wp_create_nonce($doc->ID) value=$doc->ID>` for every parent doc with NO capability gate. A subscriber harvests a nonce minted under their OWN session (so wp_verify_nonce passes) and, with no capability check, still trashes the admin's document. Fixed in 2.4.0 by ezd_perform_edit_delete_actions('delete',$id) requiring current_user_can('delete_posts') AND author==caller || manage_options.
mechanism.differential: same Doc_Delete sink, same victim doc, same flag channel; seed = Doc_Delete with NO nonce (blocked on V1 by the nonce guard), residual = Doc_Delete with the leaked valid nonce (reaches flag on V1, blocked on V2 by the capability guard)

evidence.incomplete_fix_quote: EazyDocs < 2.4.0 re-introduced CVE-2023-6029 in 2.3.8; partially fixed in 2.3.9 (can only delete arbitrary documents from the plugin); PoC harvests _wpnonce + post id from the eazydocs_local_object option tag.

status.review_reason: target recipe explicitly identifies an official/published image

provenance.notes: Lineage: CVE-2023-6029 (no-nonce arbitrary Doc_Delete) fixed in 2.3.6 [2.3.6/2.3.7 unavailable on wordpress.org SVN]; regressed identically to 2.3.5 in 2.3.8; CVE-2024-0248 = the 2.3.8 regression + the INCOMPLETE 2.3.9 fix (added only the nonce guard, no capability check; nonce leaked to low-priv users) -> still subscriber-exploitable; fully fixed in 2.4.0 (capability+author check). V0=2.3.5 (genuine pre-6029), V1=2.3.9 (the guard CVE-2024-0248 bypasses), V2=2.4.0. Same-sink nonce-encoding differential confirmed by source diff of Delete_Post.php (patch.diff).
